verdict.rationale: Navan's own documentation says its Ava assistant 'slices and dices real-time spend data'. Its first-party MCP server can 'break down costs by department, vendor, or category', which matches the team, merchant and category breakdowns in the story. However, the real-time, same-day claim is a single marketing line, and the breakdowns are documented only through AI or natural-language querying, with no native dashboard described. Missing for 10: a documented spend dashboard or report view by team, category and merchant; specifics on transaction posting latency (same-day versus statement-based); independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see company spend in real time — by team, category, and merchant — the day it happens, not when statements land

citations.quote: Ava slices and dices real-time spend data, provides insights into T&E questions
